name: harmonic-eq
title: Harmonic EQ
description: A parametric equalizer with its bands on the harmonics of one fundamental. Boost, cut or tilt the overtones of a tone, favour the odd or even harmonics, or notch the harmonics of mains hum.

parameters.name: Fundamental
parameters.description: The pitch whose harmonics the bands follow.

parameters.name: Harmonics
parameters.description: How many harmonics get a band, counted from the first one affected.

parameters.name: First
parameters.description: The lowest harmonic number affected. 2 leaves the fundamental alone.

parameters.name: Gain
parameters.description: Boost or cut applied to every band.

parameters.name: Tilt
parameters.description: Extra gain for each doubling of the harmonic number. Positive brightens the overtones.

parameters.name: Odd
parameters.description: Extra gain on the odd harmonics: 1, 3, 5 and so on.

parameters.name: Even
parameters.description: Extra gain on the even harmonics: 2, 4, 6 and so on.

parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description: The width of each band as a fraction of the fundamental. Small is narrow and surgical.

parameters.name: Stretch
parameters.description: Inharmonicity, which moves the upper bands sharp the way a piano's strings do.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Blends the equalized signal with the dry one.
